title: pvConvertToPartitionedDataSetCollection
body:
## pvConvertToPartitionedDataSetCollection

Converts any input to a vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection. Multiblock and AMR inputs get a data assembly that reproduces their hierarchy, so blocks can still be chosen by path with extractBlock or pvExtractBlock. Use it for steps or writers that require partitioned collections, such as pvWriteXMLPartitionedDataSetCollectionWriter; pvConvertToMultiBlock produces the older multiblock format.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A single dataset becomes a one-partition collection; use merge to get a plain dataset back.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ConvertToPartitionedDataSetCollection`. Identity: `filters/ConvertToPartitionedDataSetCollection`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Specify the input. Accepted data: composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable); graphs (vertices and edges) (vtkGraph). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkDataSet","vtkTable","vtkGraph"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
